020811:         // Too few arguments for the parameters the callee does declare. The
020812:         // direct call reports this from its name resolution, which never
020813:         // reaches an indirect callee: without this the shortfall used to
020814:         // travel to IR validation and be reported as a code generation
020815:         // failure naming an opcode.
020816:         if (argument_count < signature.parameter_count)

020818:             builder->failure_token_index = selected->open_index;
020819:             builder->failure_message =
020820:                 c_ir_call_arity_message(builder, selected->indirect ? (String8){0} : c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token),
020821:                                         signature, argument_count);
020822:             return false;

020824:         selected->argument_count = argument_count;

020826:         {
020827:             for (u32 argument_index = 0; argument_index < argument_count; argument_index += 1)
020828:             {
020829:                 if (c_ir_value_contains_label_provenance(builder, selected->arguments[argument_index]))
020830:                 {
020831:                     builder->failure_message = S8("a label address may not escape through a function call");
020832:                     return false;
020833:                 }
020834:             }
020835:             // The call's source range is taken before the callee, because the
020836:             // retyping below is emitted against it too.
020837:             IrSourceRange call_source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);
020838:             // Through a pre-C23 `()` pointer the call names its own
020839:             // parameters, so the pointer takes the call's signature; see
020840:             // c_ir_unprototyped_call_type.
020841:             if (signature.is_unprototyped && argument_count > signature.parameter_count)
020842:             {
020843:                 IrTypeId callee_type =
020844:                     c_ir_unprototyped_call_type(builder, signature.return_type, selected->arguments, argument_count);
020845:                 IrTypeId callee_pointer_type = callee_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
020846:                                                    ? c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, callee_type)
020847:                                                    : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
020848:                 indirect_callee = callee_pointer_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
020849:                                       ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, indirect_callee, callee_pointer_type, call_source)
020850:                                       : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
020851:                 if (indirect_callee.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
020852:                 {
020853:                     return false;
020854:                 }
020855:             }
020856:             bool terminates = signature.is_noreturn && !c_ir_lowering_resumes_after_call(builder);
020857:             IrValueId result = signature.returns_void ? (terminates ? c_ir_emit_integer_value(builder, 0, false, token) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID)
020858:                                                       : c_ir_add_result(builder, signature.return_type);
020859:             IrValueId* operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, argument_count + 1);
020860:             operands[0] = indirect_callee;
020861:             for (u32 argument_index = 0; argument_index < argument_count; argument_index += 1)
020862:             {
020863:                 operands[argument_index + 1] = selected->arguments[argument_index];
020864:             }
020865:             IrInstruction call = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_CALL, signature.return_type);
020866:             call.operands = operands;
020867:             call.operand_count = argument_count + 1;
020868:             call.result = signature.returns_void ? IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID : result;
020869:             IrInstructionId call_id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, call, call_source);
020870:             if (!signature.returns_void)
020871:             {
020872:                 builder->function->values[result.value].definition = call_id;
020873:                 selected->result = result;
020874:             }
020875:             else
020876:             {
020877:                 selected->result = terminates ? result : c_ir_emit_integer_value(builder, 0, false, token);
020878:             }
020879:             c_ir_end_control_flow_after_call(builder, signature.is_noreturn, call_source);
020880:         }
020881:         else
020882:         {
020883:             selected->result = c_ir_emit_call_values(builder, token, declaration_index, selected->arguments, argument_count);
020884:         }
020885:         if (selected->result.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
020886:         {
020887:             return false;
020888:         }
020889:         selected->emitted = true;
020890:         remaining -= 1;
020891:     } while (false);
020892:     BUSTER_CHECK(!remaining);
020893:     return true;
020894: }

020896: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_prepare_calls_step(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrLowerFrame* frame)
020897: {
020898:     CIrLowerMachine* machine = &builder->lower_machine;
020899:     if (frame->stage == C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_BEGIN)
020900:     {
020901:         frame->as.prepare_calls.previous_preparing_calls = builder->preparing_calls;
020902:         if (builder->preparing_calls)
020903:         {
020904:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, true, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
020905:             return;
020906:         }
020907:         builder->preparing_calls = true;
020908:         if (!c_ir_prepare_calls_discover(builder, frame->as.prepare_calls.start, frame->as.prepare_calls.end,
020909:                                          &frame->as.prepare_calls.emission_order, &frame->as.prepare_calls.emission_count))
020910:         {
020911:             builder->preparing_calls = frame->as.prepare_calls.previous_preparing_calls;
020912:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
020913:             return;
020914:         }
020915:         frame->as.prepare_calls.emission_index = 0;
020916:         frame->stage = C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_CHILD;
020917:     }
020918:     else if (frame->stage == C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_CHILD)
020919:     {
020920:         if (!machine->child_result.success)
020921:         {
020922:             builder->preparing_calls = frame->as.prepare_calls.previous_preparing_calls;
020923:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
020924:             return;
020925:         }
020926:         frame->as.prepare_calls.emission_index += 1;
020927:     }
020928:     if (frame->as.prepare_calls.emission_index >= frame->as.prepare_calls.emission_count)
020929:     {
020930:         builder->preparing_calls = frame->as.prepare_calls.previous_preparing_calls;
020931:         c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, true, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
020932:         return;
020933:     }
020934:     u32 call_index = frame->as.prepare_calls.emission_order[frame->as.prepare_calls.emission_index];
020935:     CIrPreparedCallState* state = arena_allocate(builder->temporary_arena, CIrPreparedCallState, 1);
020936:     *state = (CIrPreparedCallState){0};
020937:     frame->stage = C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_CHILD;
020938:     if (!c_ir_lower_frame_push(builder, (CIrLowerFrame){
020939:                                             .kind = C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_PREPARED_CALL,
020940:                                             .as.prepared_call =
020941:                                                 {
020942:                                                     .state = state,
020943:                                                     .call_index = call_index,
020944:                                                 },
020945:                                         }))
020946:     {
020947:         builder->preparing_calls = frame->as.prepare_calls.previous_preparing_calls;
020948:         c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
020949:     }
020950: }

020952: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_operation(CConditionalOperator operation, IrUnaryOperation* unary, IrBinaryOperation* binary)
020953: {
020954:     *unary = IR_UNARY_COUNT;
020955:     *binary = IR_BINARY_COUNT;
020956:     switch (operation)
020957:     {
020958:     case C_CONDITIONAL_UNARY_PLUS:
020959:         return true;
020960:     case C_CONDITIONAL_UNARY_MINUS:
020961:         *unary = IR_UNARY_INTEGER_NEGATE;
020962:         return true;
020963:     case C_CONDITIONAL_BITWISE_NOT:
020964:         *unary = IR_UNARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_NOT;
020965:         return true;
020966:     case C_CONDITIONAL_ADDRESS_OF:
020967:     case C_CONDITIONAL_DEREFERENCE:
020968:     case C_CONDITIONAL_CAST:
020969:     case C_CONDITIONAL_REAL_PART:
020970:     case C_CONDITIONAL_IMAGINARY_PART:
020971:         return true;
020972:     case C_CONDITIONAL_MULTIPLY:
020973:         *binary = IR_BINARY_INTEGER_MULTIPLY;
020974:         return true;
020975:     case C_CONDITIONAL_DIVIDE:
020976:         *binary = IR_BINARY_SIGNED_DIVIDE;
020977:         return true;
020978:     case C_CONDITIONAL_REMAINDER:
020979:         *binary = IR_BINARY_SIGNED_REMAINDER;
020980:         return true;
020981:     case C_CONDITIONAL_ADD:
020982:         *binary = IR_BINARY_INTEGER_ADD;
020983:         return true;
020984:     case C_CONDITIONAL_SUBTRACT:
020985:         *binary = IR_BINARY_INTEGER_SUBTRACT;
020986:         return true;
020987:     case C_CONDITIONAL_SHIFT_LEFT:
020988:         *binary = IR_BINARY_SHIFT_LEFT;
020989:         return true;
020990:     case C_CONDITIONAL_SHIFT_RIGHT:
020991:         *binary = IR_BINARY_SIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT;
020992:         return true;
020993:     case C_CONDITIONAL_BITWISE_AND:
020994:         *binary = IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND;
020995:         return true;
020996:     case C_CONDITIONAL_BITWISE_XOR:
020997:         *binary = IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_XOR;
020998:         return true;
020999:     case C_CONDITIONAL_BITWISE_OR:
021000:         *binary = IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_OR;
021001:         return true;
021002:     case C_CONDITIONAL_LESS:
021003:         *binary = IR_BINARY_SIGNED_LESS;
021004:         return true;
021005:     case C_CONDITIONAL_LESS_EQUAL:
021006:         *binary = IR_BINARY_SIGNED_LESS_EQUAL;
021007:         return true;
